# `revision.approve`

<!-- Generated by `cargo xtask docs-gen` from crates/ew-commands/schemas/revision.approve.schema.json. Do not edit: change the source and regenerate. -->

`revision.approve` (`ApproveRevision`): the checker's sign-off on the open revision (doc 15 §5.4; FR-REV-005,
FR-REV-021; WP-S1.18 D9): writes the revision's `checker` and its `sign_off {checker, content_digest, date, packs,
scheme, waivers_ack}`, the one path that writes the checker of an open revision (D4, FT-402). A later content edit
changes the content digest, and EW-REL-001 then reports the sign-off as stale; approving again replaces it.

The session submits it after the release gate on the saved generation (`ew_api::Session::approve`): the gate's
content digest, scheme and pack versions are its parameters, and the session refuses it unless the gate's only open
errors are EW-REL-001's and every safety-kind waiver in force is acknowledged in `waivers_ack`. The command itself
checks what the snapshot decides. Rejected: a revision that does not exist, or is not open (released and withdrawn
revisions are immutable, FR-REV-009; at `/revision`); an open revision without an author (at `/revision`: four eyes
compare two parties, so the author is set first, `revision.set_author`); a checker equal to the author (at
`/checker`, D-34, EW-INV-018); a scheme that does not ship (at `/scheme`); an acknowledged waiver that does not exist
or is listed twice (at `/waivers_ack/<i>`). The acknowledged waivers are written in ID order.

**Exposure `HumanOnly`** (doc 15 §5.4, ADR-0008 amendment 3): command logs, scripts, MCP and plugins get
`CmdError::Exposure`; on the command line only `ew revision approve` submits it, after the person types the revision
label on an interactive terminal. Interactive; undoable as one step. Outcome: none.

## Types

### ApprovedPack

One rule pack of the gate run a checker approved: its ID, version and the SHA-256 of its definition (doc 15 §3.9).

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | [`CmdIdent`](#cmdident) | yes |  | The pack ID (`EW-CORE`). |
| `sha256` | [`Sha256`](#sha256) | yes |  | The SHA-256 of the pack's definition. |
| `version` | [`CmdIdent`](#cmdident) | yes |  | The pack version. |

### CmdIdent

An identifier: non-empty, one line, NFC, without leading or trailing white space (doc 05 §3.2).

Type: string (at least 1 character(s))

Pattern: `^[^\u0000-\u0020\u007F-\u00A0\u1680\u2000-\u200A\u2028\u2029\u202F\u205F\u3000](?:[^\u0000-\u001F\u007F-\u009F]*[^\u0000-\u0020\u007F-\u00A0\u1680\u2000-\u200A\u2028\u2029\u202F\u205F\u3000])?$`

### CmdUuid

A lower-case hyphenated UUID naming a record (doc 05 §3.2).

Type: string (at least 36 character(s), at most 36 character(s))

Pattern: `^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$`

### Date

An authored date YYYY-MM-DD (doc 05 §3.2).

Type: string (pattern `^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$`)

Pattern: `^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$`

### PartyRole

The role of a `Party`.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `"customer"` | Customer. |
| `"end_user"` | End user. |
| `"panel_builder"` | Panel builder (legal owner of the drawings). |
| `"author"` | Author. |
| `"checker"` | Checker. |
| `"engineer"` | Engineer. |

### Sha256

A SHA-256 digest sha256:&lt;64 lower-case hex> (doc 05 §3.2).

Type: string (pattern `^sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$`)

Pattern: `^sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$`

## Exit codes

A command runs as one line of a command log replayed by `ew apply` ([doc 17 §3.5](https://github.com/Ironkode787/ElektraWatt/blob/main/docs/design/17-extensibility.md#35-command-logs-ewcmd)). The exit code of `ew apply` is:

| Code | Meaning |
|---|---|
| 0 | The line committed as one transaction. |
| 1 | A prevent rule or the command's own domain rule refused the line (`Prevented`, `Rejected`); without `--one-step` the lines before it stay committed and are saved, with `--one-step` nothing is saved. |
| 2 | Anything else stops the replay: invalid parameters, a missing record, an unresolvable reference, an open, lock or save error. |

The codes of every subcommand are in [doc 17 §3.2](https://github.com/Ironkode787/ElektraWatt/blob/main/docs/design/17-extensibility.md#32-exit-codes).

Exposure class `human_only`: [doc 17 §2.3](https://github.com/Ironkode787/ElektraWatt/blob/main/docs/design/17-extensibility.md#23-origins-and-exposure-classes) says whether a command log may run it.
